description: Java class 'IdeaITNProxy' handles error reporting and thread creation via HTTP POST requests to a remote server, including assembling parameters, sending requests, and processing responses.

classes.name: IdeaITNProxy
classes.description: Handles error report thread creation and parameter assembly for communication with remote server.

methods.name: postNewThread
methods.description: Sends a request to create a new error report thread on the server, processes response, and throws exceptions based on server reply.

methods.name: getKeyValuePairs
methods.description: Constructs a list of key-value pairs representing parameters for the error report, including application and environment info.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads entire InputStream content into a String.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats Calendar object into a string timestamp.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with given URL and byte array payload, returns HttpURLConnection.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Encodes list of parameters into URL-encoded byte array for POST request.
